# charly feature — inspect plan-shaped entity descriptions

`charly feature` enumerates a project's plan-shaped entity descriptions (the Agent
Driven Evaluation surface). Served by `candy/plugin-feature` (`command:feature`,
compiled-in).

## Command tree

- `charly feature list [kind]` — every feature entity (optionally filtered by kind).
- `charly feature pending [entity]` — entities whose plan has not yet been run/graded.
- `charly feature validate [entity]` — validate an entity's plan/description shape
  (plan-step keywords, the ADE description contract).

## What a feature is

A candy's `description:` + `plan:` is its acceptance test. Each plan item has exactly
one intent — `run:` changes state, `check:` probes idempotently, `agent-run:` may
mutate, `agent-check:` assesses live state read-only, `include:` composes another
plan.

## The RUN verbs (separate)

The acceptance RUN verbs — `charly box feature run` / `charly check feature run` —
are children of `box`/`check` in the core binary, not this plugin. See
[`/charly-check:check`](/recipes/check/check/) for the run + agent-grading flow.
